geometry: 29 by 14 display with a rounded black bezel, dark vertical gradient and top highlight. The green x is a single deliberate diagonal shape; the 100 glyphs are straight vector paths. Glyphs occupy y=3–11 and use #0bd556.
limitations: The screen gradient, antialiasing and diagonal x approximate the original pixel-level shading. Native and 8x renders were generated, and the 8x render was visually inspected.
